description: This file defines the ConnectException class, which represents an exception thrown when a network connection cannot be established in the Guzzle HTTP client library. It includes properties and methods to access the related HTTP request and handler context information.

classes.name: ConnectException
classes.description: An exception class thrown when a network connection cannot be established, extending TransferException and implementing NetworkExceptionInterface, containing request and handler context data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ConnectException class, initializes the exception with a message, request, optional previous throwable, and handler context.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the exception.

methods.name: getHandlerContext
methods.description: Returns contextual information about the error from the underlying handler.
